sections.title: WORKOUT
lines: Optimal Nutrition: The Goalpost Doesn't Move

Everyone's got an opinion on food. Ours hasn't changed in 25 years, because it works. Food quality and quantity. Activity levels. Strategies that hold up for everyday athletes, elite competitors, and anyone managing chronic disease. This episode digs into all of it. No trends. No gimmicks. Just what the science and hundreds of thousands of CrossFit athletes have proven. And if you want to learn even more about how to dial in your nutrition or help others do the same, check out our Applied Nutrition courses near you.

sections.title: WORKOUT
lines: Max shuttle box jump-overs in the remaining time
*Every minute, starting at 0:00, complete 4 shuttle box jump-overs.

For the shuttle box jump-overs, mark two lines 10 feet apart and place the box in the middle. To complete 1 rep, start standing behind the first marked line, run to the box, jump over the box, run past the second marked line, and make a two-hand and two-foot touch behind the line before starting the next rep.
If you have a weight vest (14/20 lb), use it.

sections.title: WORKOUT
lines: Ring Training Part 2: The Ring Positions Every Athlete Should Own

Six positions form the entire foundation for ring work: the support hold, ring rows, ring pull-ups, ring push-ups, ring dips, and the false grip. Skip any one of them and the rings will find the gap. Part 2 of our series breaks down each piece so your first muscle-up attempt isn't your first real test of them.
